g.text: One credited entry of the closure walk
counts move only by credit, and children are credited only by the domains that crossed
first visit in the epoch: distinct-object
bounded read, length and digest check,
push Exit(r, x), then one Enter(t, x',
ResourceLimit, CounterOverflow, or a load error
cold current state: Current and Retained;
each historical state and the successor inventory: Retained.
On a quiescent predecessor, the first entry of an object
happens at a first visit, which always expands:
refusal never fires. After the epoch
